title: Path of Exile 2 0.5.4e — Shader, Vulkan and First-Load Performance
summary: 0.5.4e is a technical patch. It explains why the first load after a patch can be slower, what Shader recompilation means, what changed for Vulkan/Steam, and which symptoms are normal vs仍需排查.
description: A troubleshooting page, not a gameplay patch. DX12, Vulkan, NVIDIA/AMD and PC/Console reports must not be merged into one conclusion.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: A storm-darkened ruined city representing the 0.5.4e Shader and performance update

versions.summary: Oath Rune fix; separate from the 0.5.4e technical changes.
Shader loading, Vulkan cache and VSync default changes on this page.

cards.detail: Shaders recompile after the patch. This is normal and distinct from a true performance regression.
Targets the Shader Cache sometimes ballooning. Does not apply to DX12 or Standalone the same way.
Adaptive is no longer recommended because of frame-pacing issues.
Some players report smoother maps, others still report crashes or scene stutter. No single universal claim.

sections.title: Official changes, reorganised by player problem

changes.title: Shader loading improved and size reduced
changes.detail: First entry may recompile Shaders; later entries are faster. Judge by repeat run, not first run.
changes.scope: official-fact: affects all platforms after update

changes.title: Steam Vulkan Fossilize layer disabled
changes.detail: Aims at Shader Cache abnormal growth. Specific to Steam + Vulkan; do not attribute to DX12.

changes.title: Default VSync changed to Capped
changes.detail: Adaptive is dropped because of frame-pacing issues.

changes.title: Residual crash / stutter cases
changes.detail: Some reports persist; they are not yet confirmed as fully resolved and stay in Known Issues.

sections.title: First run vs repeat run
sections.oldText: Measuring FPS only on the first area entry after the patch and concluding the patch hurt performance.
sections.newText: Separate the first compiled entry from repeat entries; compare repeat-run FPS before and after the patch.

environments.note: Check first Shader recompile, Steam Shader Cache size and Vulkan stability. Do not borrow DX12 or Console conclusions.
Separate first compile from later loads. The Fossilize change targets Steam + Vulkan, not DX12 directly.
Standalone does not use the Steam Fossilize layer. Check renderer, drivers, cache directory and behaviour after repeated entry.
Official 0.5.4e notes describe Shader and Vulkan/Steam behaviour. Console reports must be recorded separately, not merged with PC.

reports.quote: Shader count dropped noticeably, but results still vary by hardware.
reports.analysis: Body must split by renderer, platform and first-vs-repeat run; cannot say '0.5.4e fully fixed stutter'.

reports.quote: Some still crash or stutter in specific scenes after the patch.
reports.analysis: Keep as community report; do not upgrade to a verified mechanical claim.
